D1_PHASE1_MECHANISM_IS_MATHEMATICALLY_IM.explanation: exp(s/tau) is a strictly monotone map of s for every tau>0. A monotone map preserves the argmax SET exactly. Float32 exp additionally MERGES distinct scores, so the group GROWS 24.27 -> 27.24 -> 39.0. No tau can produce 'unique argmax fraction = 1.0'. The corrected decomposition is TWO STAGE: (1) max-group membership, (2) a within-group key that is NOT a monotone function of the similarity.
